name: National Building Code of India (NBC) 2016, Part 4 - Fire and Life Safety
description: Prescribes fire and life safety design, means of escape, and fire protection system requirements for buildings including warehouses.

name: State Fire Prevention and Life Safety Act / Fire NOC Rules
description: Governs issuance and renewal of Fire NOC, mandatory fire fighting installations, and periodic fire safety audits for industrial premises.

name: Factories Act 1948 and State Factories Rules
description: Governs occupational health, safety, and welfare of workers, including machinery guarding, hazardous processes, and safety officers.

name: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016
description: Regulates generation, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous waste including used oil, batteries, and packaging waste.

name: Solid Waste Management Rules 2016
description: Governs segregation, collection, storage, and disposal of solid/dry waste generated at industrial and warehousing premises.

name: Static and Mobile Pressure Vessels (Unfired) Rules / Petroleum Rules
description: Regulates storage and handling licences for flammable gases, petroleum products, and pressure vessels used in warehouse operations.

name: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 (RRFSO)
description: Primary UK fire safety legislation requiring a Responsible Person to carry out fire risk assessments and maintain fire precautions.

name: Building Regulations 2010, Approved Document B - Fire Safety
description: Sets means of escape, fire compartmentation, and fire protection system design standards for non-domestic buildings including warehouses.

name: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974
description: General duty legislation requiring employers to ensure health, safety, and welfare of employees and others affected by work activities.

name: Control of Major Accident Hazards (COMAH) Regulations 2015
description: Regulates sites storing hazardous substances above threshold quantities, requiring major accident prevention policies and safety reports.

name: Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016
description: Governs environmental permits for waste operations, hazardous waste storage, and pollution prevention at industrial sites.
